title: bora-workbench mode/v1
description: Declarative behavior contract for one launcher mode.

schema.description: Versioned schema identifier for this mode.

id.description: Stable mode identifier, equal to the file name without its extension.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the mode behavior.

services.description: Services explicitly enabled or disabled by the mode.

ui.description: Whether the integrated llama.cpp web interface is enabled.

vision.description: Whether multimodal projection and image input are enabled.

sampling.description: Sampling behavior verified for the mode during Spike 0.

temp.description: Sampling temperature passed to the model server.

top_p.description: Cumulative probability threshold used for nucleus sampling.

top_k.description: Maximum number of highest-probability tokens retained for sampling.
